name: Story creator / editor should be the same component
description:
- Right now if I go to create a story, then go back in and edit the story, I get two different UI's.

- Align UI so that when I edit the story, the UI matches the same window I see when I'm creating a story

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 5/10. Continuing codex/row-43-shared-story-editor from current origin/main. Plan: share the create/edit window; stage existing Tasks, Specs and Links; save all changes together; update affected docs; independently validate and capture screenshots before opening a draft PR.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Factory scope decision from sunny: editing must match the full creation window, including Tasks, Specs and Links tabs, with changes saved together.
